**Available in this first release.** Begin with [adverse selection](chapters/adverse-selection.html), continue to the [dealer-pricing lab](chapters/dealer-pricing.html), or work through the [HKTVmall shortage case](cases/hktvmall.html). The other topics below form the publication plan.

## Choose a reading route

| Route | Chapter sequence |
| --- | --- |
| Essentials | 1 → 2 → 5 → 6 → 7 → 12 → 15 → 17 → 21 → 23 → 24 → 28 |
| Investment analysis | 5 → 6 → 7 → 8 → 9 → 10 → 22 → 25 |
| Credit and banking | 12 → 13 → 14 → 17 → 24 → 25 → 29 |
| Corporate treasury in Hong Kong | 3 → 5 → 25 → 26 → 27 → 28 → 29 |
| Markets and fintech | 1 → 12 → 15 → 16 → 19 → 20 |

## Part I. Markets, firms, and prices

- 1. What can a price move tell us?
- 2. Demand, substitution, and elasticity
- 3. Costs, capacity, and market power
- 4. Welfare, incidence, and rationing

## Part II. Risk, valuation, and investment

- 5. Saving, borrowing, and project appraisal
- 6. Risk sharing and insurance
- 7. State prices and the value of insurance in a downturn
- 8. Diversification and portfolio choice
- 9. Which risks command a premium?
- 10. Behavioral finance and limits to arbitrage

## Part III. Strategy, information, and financial contracts

- 11. Entry, commitment, and strategic competition
- **12. Adverse selection, signaling, and screening** · [Read the opening lesson](chapters/adverse-selection.html)
- 13. Moral hazard and incentives
- 14. Debt, equity, and financing a new project
- **15. Order flow, bid–ask spreads, and price discovery** · [Open the complete lesson and lab](chapters/dealer-pricing.html)
- 16. Auctions, IPO allocation, and the winner’s curse

## Part IV. Banks, platforms, and public policy

- 17. Banks, liquidity, and runs
- **18. Public goods, externalities, and corporate responses** · [Try the companion case](cases/hktvmall.html) · chapter in development
- 19. Platform participation, reputation, and lending
- 20. Payments, settlement, and digital money

## Part V. Macroeconomics and fixed income

- 21. Reading growth, prices, and real returns
- 22. Productivity and long-run valuation
- 23. Business cycles, demand, and supply shocks
- 24. Monetary and fiscal transmission
- 25. Yield curves, duration, and refinancing

## Part VI. Trade, currencies, and international finance

- 26. Tariffs, pass-through, and supply chains
- 27. Currency exposure and hedging
- 28. Exchange-rate regimes and Hong Kong
- 29. Capital flows and foreign-currency debt

## Evidence workshops

- 30. From financial releases to a comparable chart
- 31. From co-movement to a defensible claim
